bubblebuddy.description: Primary reference for integrating discord.js with Effect 4 using scoped clients, listener lifecycles, FiberSet supervision, and drainable per-channel work.

effect-smol.description: Canonical Effect 4 implementation and test reference for current services, layers, scopes, fibers, queues, schedules, schemas, and testing APIs.

executor.description: Effect 4 application reference for service boundaries, typed error discipline, scoped resource ownership, Promise adapters, ManagedRuntime integration, and testing conventions.
